The site is Good Neighbour Community Transit — Volunteer Hospital Lift Booking, a booking web application for Volunteer driver hospital appointment lift coordination.

Owner brief: "Our village charity coordinates volunteer drivers taking elderly neighbours to entirely fictional health clinics such as 'Elmwood Community Hospital'. Schedulers must be able to log ride requests with pickup address, hospital destination, mobility aid needs, and appointment time. Ride requests must be stored on the server so volunteer drivers can view and accept pending journeys after reloading the dispatch board. Do not use Leicester Royal Infirmary, Macclesfield, or any real NHS site."

Locale & copy conventions (en-GB): Use £ prices, British English spelling, day-month dates and .co.uk-style invented domains. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-21/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Good Neighbour Community Transit — Volunteer Hospital Lift Booking: the page for volunteer driver hospital appointment lift coordination, in a light palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #0f766e (gn-teal), #0284c7 (gn-blue), #ffffff (gn-card), #cbd5e1 (gn-border), #f8fafc (gn-bg), #0f172a (gn-text), #64748b (gn-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 8px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--gn-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a calendar widget that hides the available slots behind extra clicks; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Good Neighbour Community Transit — Volunteer Hospital Lift Booking as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Passenger name", "Emergency contact phone", "Pickup address", "Destination hospital", "Appointment time", "Mobility requirements", "Access notes").

User journey context: Fill in patient transport request with pickup location, destination hospital, and appointment time. Specify wheelchair or folding walker mobility requirements and emergency contact details. Submit the ride request, receive a dispatch reference ID, and reload the dispatch board to verify.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
